messages:
maria: Proposal — add an "quiet degrade" automatic fallback mode for rollouts. Instead of hard failover, the system should silently degrade behavior (shorter responses / cached prefixes / cheaper model) and emit audit events. Thoughts?
kevin: sounds useful. main questions: what are the triggers (latency/error thresholds) and how do we quantify "silent"?
sasha: Agree with concept. Triggers could be p95 latency > 1.5x SLO OR error rate > 0.5% over 1m. For "silent" we need to surface telemetry but not return 503 to callers.
jonah: we should also consider token-usage anomalies (sudden token blowups) and model-specific errors (OOMs). Fallback on token anomalies -> cap max_tokens + switch to short context model.
anya: UX note — product wants console preview of the degraded path before enabling auto-fallback. They want a simulation button that shows expected cost/latency delta and sample outputs.
maria: thanks. rough idea for degrade modes: [1] cached-prefix (serve from KV cache when prefix matches), [2] short-mode (truncate context + reduce max_tokens), [3] alt-model (route to cheaper/quantized variant), [4] graceful-empty (return best-effort short answer).
kevin: ordering matters. we should prefer cached-prefix (lossless) then alt-model then short-mode. Graceful-empty only as last resort.
sasha: we need deterministic fallbacks to make evaluations reproducible. Also expose fallback reason tags in traces: rollout.fallback.reason and rollout.fallback.mode.
jonah: example trigger config I sketched:
```json
{"policy_name":"quiet-degrade-1","triggers":{"latency_p95_ms":1200,"error_rate_percent":0.5,"token_rate_delta":200},"sequence":["cached-prefix","alt-model","short-mode"],"audit":true}"
```
anya: console UX: modal shows sequence, estimated token change, sample diff (gold vs degraded), and a toggle for "simulate for 5m" that runs traffic through a simulator and shows telemetry.
maria: how do we record audit logs? We need an immutable event with rollout id, window, trigger metrics, chosen mode, and sample response id that can be replayed. retention = 90d by default.
kevin: audit-bot should emit: rollout.fallback.triggered -> { rollout_id, trigger_ts, cause, selected_mode, upstream_model, trace_id }. That should route to long-term logs and be queryable in Console traces.
audit-bot: noted. Will produce schema draft and an ingest pipeline PR.
sasha: also need RBAC / allowlist: only projects with allow_fallback flag can auto-fallback; others must require manual approval. Prevent silent degrade for PCI/PHI workloads.
jonah: can we add a kill-switch that operators can press that forces immediate rollback and forces no-fallback path? UI: big red "Abort auto-fallback" in rollout view.
maria: yes. Also add an opt-in per-route override: route-level policy to never fallback or to prefer alt-model.
kevin: edge cases: what if alt-model produces hallucinations? we should wire quality checks (prompt eval hooks) that reject degraded outputs with a high hallucination score and escalate to canary fallback instead.
sasha: proposal: steps when trigger fires: (1) pick candidate mode from sequence, (2) run 50% of traffic on degraded path for 30s (canary), (3) if quality metrics drop > threshold -> fallback to next mode or escalate to "degrade=manual". Otherwise roll target up to 100%. All events logged.
anya: simulate button should show these staged steps and expected telemetry chart. super helpful for PM sign-off.
maria: action items: 1) kevin/ops — define exact numeric trigger defaults and rate windows. 2) sasha/devex — add tracing tags & quality signal hooks. 3) jonah/infra — implement simulator + kill-switch API. 4) anya/product — mock console UX + sample diffs. 5) audit-bot — schema draft for rollout.fallback.* events.
kevin: I can take 1. Will propose defaults by EOD tomorrow.
sasha: will start a small PR for tags and a feature flag for allow_fallback.
jonah: I'll prototype simulator endpoints and an admin kill-switch.
anya: will wire a mockup into Figma and share.
maria: sounds good. @kevin please @mention eng-sre once defaults ready so they can validate alarms. Also we need a short runbook for oncall: what to do if degrade backfires.
kevin: will do.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag scaffold pushed to staging at 2026-03-20T14:22Z.
audit-bot: schema created: rollout.fallback.triggered.v1 -> draft link: https://internal/redwood/schemas/rollout-fallback-v1 (comments open).
maria: thanks everyone. small follow-up: can we also log sample ids for degraded outputs so we can correlate user complaints with exact fallback events?
sasha: yes, add degraded_sample_id to event and include pointer to the stored payload.
maria: perfect. closing thread — will file a ticket with the action items and link PRs. :seedling:
